text:
alana: Quick sync request 1 Delta private pilot asks landed: reserved prewarm window, KMS/HSM key integration, canary w/auto-fallback to hosted, and a 99.9% latency SLO. Need owners + blockers + realistic runway.

sam: I can cover runtime (prewarm orchestration, batching, KV-cache). What's the expected peak QPS & token mix?

alana: Estimate 180-220 qps bursts, ~18k tokens/min. Cold p99 target <150ms. Will confirm numbers with customer tomorrow.

tess: Platform: we can template the deployment and the canary policy, but private control plane needs security + KMS access before we toggle it.

ravi: Security: KMS/HSM requires vendor attestation + threat model review. Blocker window ~7-12 business days after we get SOW + key access matrix. IAM roles also need signoff.

juan: Infra: we have two A100 nodes on reserve May 10-24; cheaper T4s available but higher p99. If p99 target is strict, recommend A100. Need a hard confirm date to convert reservation.

sam: Runtime prefers A100. T4 w/quantization could be an option but expect 20-35% higher p99.

alana: Model: 7B SFT fp16. KV cache ~3GB/shard, 4 shards target. Spec link (internal): https://intra.redwood/specs/delta (placeholder).

tess: Timeline estimate: if security kicks off Mon and infra holds slots now, pilot possible in ~4-6 weeks. KMS gating is likely critical path.

ravi: Action: I'll start a pre-review today. Requesting SOW, network diagram, KMS policy, and rotation cadence.

sam: Runtime TODO (opening PRs):
```
prewarm:
  target_qps: 200
  sustain_s: 900
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 1024
  max_latency_ms: 50
kv_cache:
  enabled: true
  per_shard_gb: 3
```
Need infra endpoints and service principal.

juan: I'll tentatively hold 2x A100 for May10-24. Please confirm by EOD Friday to lock. Need final image tag + VPC CIDR.

ops-bot: Calendared "Delta private pilot planning" Thu 10:00 1 invites: @alana @sam @juan @tess @ravi.

alana: Recap actions: 1) alana: finalize traffic spec by Wed. 2) juan: hold slots; confirm EOD Fri. 3) ravi: run security pre-review (start today). 4) sam: open PRs for prewarm + request creds. 5) tess: add fallback/runbook to the meeting agenda. Call out blockers here asap. :eyes: :thumbsup:
